text:
tomas: Quick idea - what if we push warmup execution down into the runtime agent instead of the central orchestrator? Local prefetch and KV priming should reduce node-to-node transfers and lower control-plane churn.

maya: Sounds promising. Main risk is noisy warmups on shared nodes. How do we prevent a tenant warming a hot model from starving other tenants on the same machine?

alex_chen: Operator stays authoritative for policy and budgets. Operator issues tenant-scoped warmup leases to agents; agents execute within soft local quotas and per-tenant rate limits. Example lease proto: tenant_id:T123 model:gptx-7b budget_tokens:40 cancelable:true max_concurrent:2. Agent reports progress and either completes or returns partial credit. If local capacity is low, agent defers back to operator.

infra-bot: deploy-check: warmup-agent-proto schema validated.

sean: Security + billing concern: moving execution to agents increases abuse surface. Need throttle rules and billing integration so warmup units are billed or deducted from tenant budgets. Also authentication of lease tokens is critical.

maya: Also need clear behavior on node drain/eviction. If a node is drained mid-warmup, tenants should not lose their credits unexpectedly.

tomas: Proposal: leases are cancelable with a short refund-window TTL and a progress_percent field. Refund math: refund_tokens = floor(budget_tokens * (1 - progress_percent)). Agent returns warmup_progress_pct and warmup_refund_tokens when cancelled.

alex_chen: Add metrics: agent_warmup_queue_length, warmup_progress_pct, warmup_refund_tokens, warmup_retries. Operator dashboard can alert when refunds spike, indicating oscillation.

pranav: I can build a small simulator that toggles node capacity and injects drains to validate refund calc and ensure we don't oscillate credits or amplify churn.

joana: One more operational note: make warmup leases idempotent and short-lived. Agents should dedupe repeated requests to avoid double-warming after reconnect.

tomas: Agreed. Operator = policy + billing + authorization. Agents = execution + local safety + telemetry. I'll draft a short RFC with sequence diagrams, the lease proto, metrics, and the sim plan. Will loop in eng-sre for chaos tests.

maya: TL;DR: operator issues budgets, agents execute under caps, leases cancelable with refund math, metrics and sim. LGTM.
